evals.prompt: Review this Next.js product page: it fetches product data client-side in useEffect, renders a 2MB carousel library for 3 images, and re-renders the whole grid on every keystroke in the search box.
evals.expected_output: Should flag client-side fetching where server components or cached fetches fit, the oversized carousel dependency for bundle size, and the unthrottled grid re-render — each mapped to its rule category by impact.
assertions: Flags useEffect client fetching where a server-side pattern fits
Flags the 2MB carousel dependency as a bundle-size problem
Flags full-grid re-render on every keystroke
Prioritizes findings by impact per the rule categories
References specific rules rather than generic advice

evals.prompt: Write a new arrivals section for our shop: server-rendered grid, images with sizes, add-to-cart buttons.
evals.expected_output: Should write the section applying the guidelines proactively: server component data fetching, optimized images with sizes, and bundle-conscious component choices.
assertions: Uses server-side data fetching instead of client useEffect
Avoids adding heavy new dependencies for simple UI
Follows the skill's rule categories by priority

evals.prompt: Our bundle grew 400KB after adding a date library, a chart library and a modal library for one small dashboard. What do we do?
evals.expected_output: Should audit the three dependencies for lighter replacements or tree-shaking, flag importing full libraries for single uses, and propose a concrete reduction plan.
assertions: Audits each of the three dependencies individually
Flags full-library imports used for a single feature
Proposes lighter replacements or tree-shaken imports
Quantifies the bundle impact in the plan
